hawa_mahal.name: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
hawa_mahal.description: Iconic 1799 crown-shaped palace built by Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh, featuring 953 ornate latticed jharokhas that catch cool breezes.

amber_fort.name: Amer Fort & Palace
amber_fort.description: Magnificent UNESCO World Heritage hilltop citadel overlooking Maota Lake, world-famed for its dazzling Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace) and Rajput elegance.
amber_fort.best_time_to_visit: Morning (08:00 - 11:00) or Evening Sound & Light show

city_palace_jaipur.name: City Palace Jaipur
city_palace_jaipur.description: Opulent royal residence of Jaipur's Maharajas blending Mughal, Rajput, and European styles, featuring Chandra Mahal, Mubarak Mahal, and Peacock Gate.

jantar_mantar_jaipur.name: Jantar Mantar (Astronomical Observatory)
jantar_mantar_jaipur.description: UNESCO World Heritage site comprising 19 monumental astronomical instruments built in 1734 by Sawai Jai Singh II, including the world's largest stone sundial.
jantar_mantar_jaipur.best_time_to_visit: Midday (around noon) when instruments cast precise sun shadows

nahargarh_fort.name: Nahargarh Fort (Tiger Fort)
nahargarh_fort.description: Formidable ridge fort standing high on the Aravalli hills with 9 identical palace suites for royal queens, commanding sensational sunset panoramas of Jaipur.

jaigarh_fort.name: Jaigarh Fort (Victory Fort)
jaigarh_fort.description: Impregnable medieval military stronghold housing the legendary Jaivana Cannon (the world's largest cannon on wheels), subterranean water cisterns, and royal armory.

jal_mahal.name: Jal Mahal (Water Palace)
jal_mahal.description: Surreal Rajput palace appearing to float in the middle of Man Sagar Lake against the backdrop of Aravalli hills, breathtakingly illuminated at night.

albert_hall_museum.name: Albert Hall Museum (Central Museum)
albert_hall_museum.description: Rajasthan's oldest state museum designed in spectacular Indo-Saracenic style, showcasing ancient coins, miniature paintings, armor, and an authentic Egyptian mummy.
albert_hall_museum.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Also spectacular night viewing 19:00 - 22:00)

birla_mandir_jaipur.name: Birla Mandir (Laxmi Narayan Temple)
birla_mandir_jaipur.description: Stunning pure white Makrana marble temple at the foot of Moti Dungri hill, sculpted with exquisite mythological panels, Hindu deities, and philosophical sages.

galtaji_temple.name: Galtaji Temple (Monkey Temple)
galtaji_temple.description: Ancient Hindu pilgrimage nestled in a dramatic Aravalli gorge, famous for 7 sacred natural water springs (kunds), frescoed pavilions, and playful rhesus macaques.

govind_dev_ji_temple.name: Govind Dev Ji Temple
govind_dev_ji_temple.description: Beloved guardian deity of Jaipur enshrined within City Palace grounds, renowned for its Guiness-recorded pillarless flat roof satsang hall spanning 119 feet.
govind_dev_ji_temple.best_time_to_visit: Mangala Aarti (Early morning) or Sandhya Aarti

patrika_gate.name: Patrika Gate
patrika_gate.description: Spectacular pastel-hued memorial gate at Jawahar Circle entryway, renowned for 9 exquisitely hand-painted archways celebrating Rajasthan's architectural history.

jawahar_circle_garden.name: Jawahar Circle Garden & Musical Fountain
jawahar_circle_garden.description: Recognized as Asia's largest circular highway park with a 452-meter diameter, featuring landscaped rose gardens, jogging tracks, and musical fountains.
jawahar_circle_garden.best_time_to_visit: Evenings for the Musical Fountain Show (19:00)

panna_meena_ka_kund.name: Panna Meena ka Kund (Amer Stepwell)
panna_meena_ka_kund.description: Intricate 16th-century stepwell near Amer Fort famous for crisscross symmetrical geometric staircases, octagonal gazebos, and ancient water-harvesting lore.

sisodia_rani_garden.name: Sisodia Rani Garden and Palace
sisodia_rani_garden.description: Romantic terraced garden built in 1728 for the queen of Sawai Jai Singh, laid out in Charbagh style with cascading waterways, fountains, and Radha-Krishna murals.

vidyadhar_garden.name: Vidyadhar Garden
vidyadhar_garden.description: Serene terraced garden dedicated to Vidyadhar Bhattacharya, the chief architect and planner of Jaipur, featuring stone chhatris, lotus ponds, and peacocks.

moti_dungri_ganesh_temple.name: Moti Dungri Ganesh Temple
moti_dungri_ganesh_temple.description: Highly revered Ganesha sanctum located beside the Scottish castle-style Moti Dungri palace, consecrated in 1761 with an ancient Gujarat idol.

chokhi_dhani_jaipur.name: Chokhi Dhani Ethnic Resort & Village
chokhi_dhani_jaipur.description: Celebrated heritage village experience showcasing authentic Rajasthani hospitality, folk dances (Ghoomar, Kalbelia), puppet shows, camel rides, and traditional thali dining.

central_park_jaipur.name: Central Park & National Flagpole
central_park_jaipur.description: Jaipur's green lung adjacent to the Polo Grounds, featuring a 5-km jogging track, lush woods, and the tallest tricolor flagpole in Rajasthan (206 feet).

ram_niwas_garden.name: Ram Niwas Garden
ram_niwas_garden.description: Historic 33-acre royal garden created in 1868 as a famine relief project by Maharaja Ram Singh, housing Albert Hall, art galleries, and verdant avenues.

bapu_bazaar.name: Bapu Bazaar
bapu_bazaar.description: Buzzing pink-walled retail hub famous for camel-leather juttis (mojaris), Jaipuri cotton quilts (razai), block-printed kurtis, and vibrant souvenirs.

johari_bazaar.name: Johari Bazaar (Jewellery & Gem Market)
johari_bazaar.description: World-famous wholesale and retail epicenter for precious gemstones, Kundan-Meenakari bridal jewelry, semi-precious beads, and traditional sarees.

tripolia_bazaar.name: Tripolia Bazaar & Maniharon Ka Rasta
tripolia_bazaar.description: Historic avenue stretching between Chhoti Chaupar and Badi Chaupar, internationally recognized for handcrafted lacquer bangles, brassware, and iron goods.

chandpole_bazaar.name: Chandpole Bazaar (Marble Art Corridor)
chandpole_bazaar.description: Vibrant traditional market leading to the western Moon Gate, celebrated for Khazanewalon Ka Rasta where master sculptors carve marble deities and decor.
chandpole_bazaar.best_time_to_visit: Daytime for viewing live marble carving

nahargarh_biological_park.name: Nahargarh Biological Park & Lion Safari
nahargarh_biological_park.description: Expansive 720-hectare wildlife park at the foot of Aravalli ranges, featuring open enclosures for Asiatic lions, Bengal tigers, leopards, and an open safari ride.

gatore_ki_chhatriyan.name: Gatore Ki Chhatriyan (Royal Gaitor Cenotaphs)
gatore_ki_chhatriyan.description: Tranquil valley sheltering the exquisitely carved white marble and sandstone cenotaphs of the Kachwaha Maharajas, notably Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II.

kanak_vrindavan_garden.name: Kanak Vrindavan Valley Garden
kanak_vrindavan_garden.description: Lush royal garden landscaped in a picturesque valley below Amer Fort, resembling Lord Krishna's Vrindavan with marble fountains and Radha-Madhav temple.

anokhi_museum_hand_printing.name: Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing
anokhi_museum_hand_printing.description: Restored 16th-century stone haveli in Amer dedicated to preserving Rajasthan's ancestral woodblock textile printing, featuring live artisan demonstrations.

jagat_shiromani_temple.name: Jagat Shiromani Temple (Amer)
jagat_shiromani_temple.description: Splendid 17th-century sandstone and marble temple dedicated to Lord Krishna and Meera Bai, housing the exact idol worshipped by Meera in Chittorgarh.

bhangarh_fort.name: Bhangarh Fort Ruins
bhangarh_fort.description: Atmospheric 17th-century fortified town ruins nestled at the base of Aravalli mountains, famous globally for its historical ruins, banyan trees, and folklore.
bhangarh_fort.best_time_to_visit: Winter day trip (Entry strictly banned after sunset)

samode_palace.name: Samode Palace & Heritage Village
samode_palace.description: 475-year-old aristocratic palace in Samode village renowned for the jaw-dropping Sultan Mahal and Sheesh Mahal adorned with glass mosaic and gold leaf murals.

jawahar_kala_kendra.name: Jawahar Kala Kendra (JKK Arts Hub)
jawahar_kala_kendra.description: Celebrated modern multi-arts centre designed by visionary architect Charles Correa, structured on Jaipur's 9-square Navagraha astronomical grid.
jawahar_kala_kendra.best_time_to_visit: Afternoons and evenings (Art exhibitions and cafe)

statue_circle.name: Statue Circle
statue_circle.description: Prominent circular landmark in C-Scheme featuring a life-sized white marble statue of Jaipur founder Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II, famous for evening cold coffees.

akshardham_temple_jaipur.name: Akshardham Temple (Vaishali Nagar)
akshardham_temple_jaipur.description: Ornate Swaminarayan temple complex in Vaishali Nagar featuring sculpted pink sandstone pillars, lush lawns, and idols adorned with silver and gold leaf.

amar_jawan_jyoti_jaipur.name: Amar Jawan Jyoti Memorial
amar_jawan_jyoti_jaipur.description: Touching war memorial opposite the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly, keeping an eternal flame burning in honor of fallen Rajasthani soldiers and martyrs.

world_trade_park.name: World Trade Park (WTP Jaipur)
world_trade_park.description: Monumental futuristic twin-block mega mall spanning over JLN Marg with an overhead footbridge, world-class luxury brands, and an international food court.

jaipur_wax_museum.name: Jaipur Wax Museum (Nahargarh Fort)
jaipur_wax_museum.description: Located within the premises of Nahargarh Fort, exhibiting 30+ lifelike wax and silicon statues of Rajasthan Maharajas, national heroes, and film celebrities.

khole_ke_hanumanji.name: Khole Ke Hanuman Ji Temple
khole_ke_hanumanji.description: Scenic hillside Hanuman temple situated in Laxman Dungri valley, equipped with Jaipur's first passenger ropeway offering breathtaking valley panoramas.

isarlat_swargasuli.name: Isarlat (Sargasooli Tower to Heaven)
isarlat_swargasuli.description: Historic 140-foot victory minaret built in 1749 by Maharaja Sawai Ishwari Singh; climbing its spiral ramp offers the grandest bird's-eye view of Jaipur's Pink City.

chand_baori_abhaneri.name: Chand Baori Stepwell (Abhaneri)
chand_baori_abhaneri.description: One of the world's deepest and largest stepwells built in the 9th century, featuring 3,500 precisely cut symmetrical steps descending 13 stories into the earth.

raj_mandir_cinema.name: Raj Mandir Cinema (Pride of Asia)
raj_mandir_cinema.description: Legendary art-deco single-screen movie palace opened in 1976, celebrated for its meringue-like lobby ceiling, chandeliers, and royal cinema viewing experience.

smriti_van_jaipur.name: Kapur Chand Kulish Smriti Van
smriti_van_jaipur.description: Sprawling 108-acre biodiversity city forest along JLN Marg, offering shady winding earthen nature trails, herbal plantations, and abundant peacock birdlife.

masala_chowk.name: Masala Chowk (Open-Air Food Court)
masala_chowk.description: Open-air gastronomic hub in Ram Niwas Garden bringing together 21 of Jaipur's legendary historic street food brands under one roof.

tarkeshwar_mahadev_temple.name: Tarkeshwar Mahadev Temple
tarkeshwar_mahadev_temple.description: Revered Shiva temple at Chaura Rasta housing an ancient self-manifested (Swayambhu) black marble Shiva Lingam said to predate the foundation of Jaipur.

sanghiji_jain_temple_sanganer.name: Shri Digambar Jain Atishaya Kshetra (Sanghiji Sanganer)
sanghiji_jain_temple_sanganer.description: Ancient 10th-century red stone Jain temple complex in Sanganer, featuring seven sky-high spires (shikharas) and sacred underground meditation chambers.

dravyavati_river_project.name: Dravyavati Riverfront Landscape Park
dravyavati_river_project.description: Modern revitalized urban riverfront park stretching through the southern corridor with walking promenades, illuminated water weirs, and botanical groves.

blue_pottery_craft_studios.name: Jaipur Blue Pottery Craft Studios
blue_pottery_craft_studios.description: Traditional artisan studios producing GI-tagged Jaipur Blue Pottery, uniquely crafted without clay using quartz stone, raw glass, and vibrant turquoise Egyptian motifs.

surajpole_gate.name: Surajpole Gate (Sun Gate of Walled City)
surajpole_gate.description: Historic eastern entry portal to the Walled City facing the rising sun towards Galta Hills, flanked by monumental stone bastions and imperial ramparts.

shree_ramchandra_ji_temple.name: Shree Ramchandra Ji Temple (Sirah Deori)
shree_ramchandra_ji_temple.description: Majestic haveli-style temple situated near Hawa Mahal on Sirah Deori Bazaar, built by the queens of Sawai Ram Singh II with vibrant wall frescoes.

stepwell_choti_chaupar.name: Historic Stepwells of Chhoti Chaupar
stepwell_choti_chaupar.description: Ancient underground kund stepwell unearthed and preserved during Jaipur Metro tunneling, showcasing the ingenious historical water engineering of the Pink City.
stepwell_choti_chaupar.best_time_to_visit: Daytime while exploring Chhoti Chaupar Metro
